title: Latvian PM Kulbergs given Ukrainian honour
summary_full: During a working visit to Kyiv, on August 24th Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs (United List) was presented with a Ukrainian state award – the Order of Merit, 1st degree – by Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, as a token of gratitude for Latvia's significant support to Ukraine.
